# An effect in a block of a view that declares state, under a loop: each copy
# of the block mounts once and its @mount writes that copy's own cell. If
# `seen` were one cell every copy shared, the three mounts would add 1, 2
# and 3. On bubbletea the block is a cell per copy, and the effect's handlers
# are handed the copy's key through `on`, since the settle runs them outside
# the loop the key is built from.
#
# testdata/view_block_state_renders_nothing.txtar is the code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

[gtk4] sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
[gtk4] stdout 'PASS'
[gtk4] ! stdout 'FAIL'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
! stdout 'FAIL'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:test"

component counter ui.node {
    var items = [1, 2, 3]
    var total = 0

    ui.vbox {
        for var i = items {
            var seen = 0
            effect(@mount {
                seen = seen + 1
                total = total + seen
            })
        }
        ui.button #more(text="more", @click { items.push(4) })
    }
}

func testEachCopyMountsWithItsOwnCell(t test.Test, c counter) {
    t.assert(c.total == 3)
}

func testANewCopyMountsAlone(t test.Test, c counter) {
    c.more.click()
    t.assert(c.total == 4)
}
